title: Integral continuous-map condensed coefficient ring
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension. Let $R=\mathcal O_E$ with the canonical valuation topology of [def-sfb-continuous-lattice-coefficients]. Define $\underline R$ to be the continuous-map condensed ring of [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] applied to this topological ring: its sections on a profinite set $S$ are $C(S,R)$, with precomposition restrictions and pointwise operations. Regard it as an abelian sheaf with the canonical monoid-object structure of that construction and its canonical commutativity instance.

source.place: Example 3.1, continuous-map condensed rings and rings of integers of extensions of Q_l
